title: PreparedDocument
description: The codomain of the organizing knowledge-vault document-write surface (create-document / update-frontmatter): a frontmatter document encoded via @emsenn/relating's markdown codec, dry-run by default. `path` is the confined vault-relative path, `text` the encoded document, `written` whether it was actually placed (only on --write). $id is the bare package-rooted descent path.

path.description: the vault-relative path the document is prepared for

written.description: whether the document was placed (true only when --write was set)
